kept.decision_summary: Council approved transit priority measures for the 505 Dundas 6-Minute Network. Weekday 'No Stopping' rules on Dundas Street West were extended so that both sides of the street are covered in both the morning and afternoon peaks. Before this, some sections had the rule in only one peak. The documents name no specific transit stops.
kept.quote: The change to curbside regulations proposed in this report is to have ‘No Stopping' coverage in both the AM and PM peak periods on both sides of the street, where it is currently only AM or PM.

kept.decision_summary: Under the same item, left-turn restrictions were added or extended at intersections on Dundas Street West, including Bloor Street West, Clarens Avenue and Sheridan Avenue. The goal is to cut delays caused by vehicles turning left from the lane shared with the streetcar.
kept.quote: Vehicles turning left from the shared streetcar lane can result in significant delays to streetcar operations.

kept.decision_summary: A second document for this item, at City Council, adds more 'No Stopping' changes on Dundas Street West sections, including Dovercourt Avenue to Ossington Avenue and Ossington Avenue to Augusta. It also extends turn restrictions, for example the westbound left turn at University Avenue.
kept.quote: In these sections, the curbside regulations will be updated so each side of the street has ‘No Stopping' in both peak periods, from Monday to Friday.

kept.decision_summary: This is the initial findings report on the 505 Dundas transit priority measures, adopted by Council on 2026-07-30. It confirms the measures supported 6-minute service on the 505 Dundas streetcar, which the earlier report says Council authorized in December 2025. It reports a 20% increase in ridership. The start time is cut off in the passage, but the trips are 6 minutes apart from 7:00 a.m.
kept.quote: DECISION HISTORY On December 16 and 17, 2025, City Council authorized transit priority measures (TPMs) to support 6-minute headways on the 505 Dundas streetcar route Agenda Item History - 2025.
